name: zeus-ai
description: Zeus AI — your AI coding companion in VS Code. Chat, explain, fix, refactor, and generate code with Zeus's centralized AI backend.

zeus.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Zeus backend API base URL. The extension sends authenticated chat requests to this domain. Must serve the Zeus /api/chat endpoint.

zeus.supabaseUrl.markdownDescription: Public Supabase project URL used for authentication. Override only for development/testing against a different project.

zeus.supabaseAnonKey.markdownDescription: Public Supabase **publishable (anon)** key used for authentication. This is the same public key the Zeus web app ships in its client bundle — it is **not** a secret and must never be replaced with a service-role key.

zeus.privacy.respectGitignore.markdownDescription: Skip files matched by the workspace `.gitignore` when building project context. Sensitive files (.env, keys, credentials) are ALWAYS excluded regardless of this setting.

zeus.privacy.extraBlockedPatterns.markdownDescription: Additional glob patterns to exclude from all Zeus context (e.g. `internal/**`). Applied on top of the built-in privacy rules, which cannot be relaxed.

zeus.context.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum number of file paths included in a workspace scan manifest.

zeus.context.maxFileKB.markdownDescription: Maximum size (KB) of any single file included in context.

zeus.context.maxTotalKB.markdownDescription: Maximum total size (KB) of all context sent in one request.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-otp.mjs && node scripts/test-chat.mjs && node scripts/test-phase3.mjs && node scripts/test-update-version.mjs
